test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT true?

options.text: Social media can offer a substitute for real-life social interaction.
Lack of social interaction may cause anxiety and depression.
Social bonds have a strong influence on our mental health.
Humans need to reassess their social media usage.

solution:
The correct answer is Social media can offer a substitute for real-life social interaction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the passage:

 
 
• While each has its own set of advantages, it's vital to realise that social media will never be a substitute for genuine human interaction.
 
• To prosper in life, we require the company of others, and the strength of our bonds has a significant influence on our mental health and happiness.
 
• On the other hand, a lack of strong social relationships might put your mental and emotional health in danger.
 
• It's time to re-evaluate your online habits and establish a healthier balance. 
 
 
 
• Hence from the above mentioned points we can conclude that the statement 'Social media can offer a substitute for real-life social interaction' is **not true.**
 
• Thus option 1 is the correct answer
